description: This file defines custom formatters for specific PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) data structures used in 5G NR (New Radio) protocol processing, including codeword descriptions and PDU formatting.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdsch_processor::codeword_description>
classes.description: Custom formatter for codeword_description, formats modulation and redundancy version.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdsch_processor::pdu_t>
classes.description: Custom formatter for pdu_t, formats various PDSCH PDU fields including RNTI, resource blocks, symbols, codewords, and protocol-specific parameters.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the respective data structure into a string representation.
